name: Lajosmizse (Hungary)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the town arms of Lajosmizse: a small blue shield with a helm and red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Lajosmizse arms with helm and mantling
